title: Multi-Variant Rollout Preview — keyboard-first interactions & SR narration handoff
creator: Maya Patel
description: Finalize and hand off a keyboard-first, screen-reader-friendly variant preview panel for multi-variant rollouts. Deliver high-fidelity specs for focus states, live narration copy, and microcopy for empty/edge states so engineering and QA can implement accessibility-first behaviors alongside the visual preview.
acceptance_criteria: Figma spec includes keyboard tab order, visible focus rings for all interactive elements, and 2x contrast-compliant focus styles.
Screen-reader narration script (ARIA live regions + polite/urgent patterns) provided and validated by accessibility PM.
Prototype (link) demonstrates full keyboard flows, variant selection, and fallback state with documented QA testcases.
updates: 2026-02-28: Ticket created after design sync with PM and Accessibility lead (A. Chen). Initial draft of focus styles attached.
2026-03-03: UX research run with 6 participants (keyboard-only). Observed confusion when variant badges were announced without context; updated microcopy to include variant role + percentage summary.

2026-03-06: Engineering sync - ENG flagged potential perf impact of live region updates on high-frequency traffic. Agreed to debounce announcements (500ms) and mark urgent updates for rollouts that change traffic allocation.
2026-03-09: Design review with stakeholders (PM, Eng, Accessibility). Minor visual polish requested on focus ring thickness and accent color to meet 2x WCAG contrast target.
2026-03-12: Hand-off branch PR opened (see GitHub link). Ready for implementation review; requesting QA slot for 2026-03-18.
review_feedback: PM (J. Alvarez): Ensure microcopy aligns with rollout audit logs — added unique ID in narration to support tie-back.
Accessibility Lead (A. Chen): Prefer 'polite' ARIA live region for non-critical var changes; urgent when variant allocation change > 10%.
Frontend Eng (S. Liu): Prefer CSS-only focus outlines where possible; provided polyfill guidance for older browsers in the engineering notes.
Design Ops (R. Singh): Request separate tokens for focus color to avoid global token collisions in other console components.
decision_log: Debounced SR announcements to 500ms to avoid noisy narration during rapid edits (decision recorded 2026-03-06).
Use 'Variant X — 25% traffic' microcopy pattern for badge narration for consistent grammar across locales (decision 2026-03-09).
Focus rings implemented using a dedicated token 'focus-ring-rollout-preview' with contrast rules validated by the accessibility checklist (decision 2026-03-10).
handoff_items: Figma page 'Variant Preview / Accessibility' with annotated tab order and focus states.
ARIA narration scripts for: variant selection, allocation change (polite + urgent), empty state, and error states.
Prototype demonstrating keyboard-only flow (focus, selection, close, and edit allocation).
QA test cases list and suggested assertions for e2e tests (aria-live presence, focus after action, persistent focus after modal close).
Implementation notes for debouncing live-region updates and handling multiple simultaneous variant edits.
qa_notes: Test 1: Tab through preview panel, ensure focus order matches Figma and each actionable has visible focus ring.
Test 2: With screen-reader on (NVDA/VoiceOver), select variant and confirm live region announces 'Variant <name> — <x>% traffic'.
Test 3: Simulate rapid allocation updates (5 updates in <1s) and confirm only one polite announcement occurs after 500ms.
Test 4: Low-contrast mode — verify focus token still meets 2x contrast requirement and is readable on cost tiles behind the panel.
risk_and_tradeoffs: Tradeoff: Debouncing SR announcements reduces noise but introduces a small delay; acceptable for UX to avoid overload.
Risk: CSS-only focus styles may be overridden by app-level tokens in some legacy workspaces. Mitigation: scope token with BEM-like class 'rw-rollout-preview'.
Performance risk: Live-region updates on dashboards with many concurrent users. Mitigation: engineering to sample rate-limit announcements server-side if client debouncing insufficient.
next_steps: Engineering: implement per-spec and open a PR referencing this ticket (assigned to ENG-6242).
Design: pair with frontend on first pass to validate focus behavior in-browser (2-hour session).
QA: schedule testing window for 2026-03-18 and add automated accessibility checks to CI.
PM: Confirm release gating and whether this ships in console-2026.03 or console-2026.04.
